section: Hypervisor Trunks / Wireless Access Point Trunks
content:
# Hypervisor Trunks / Wireless Access Point Trunks

A trunk connected to a hypervisor may carry multiple VLANs.

Document:

- Physical SRX port
- Switch port
- Hypervisor port
- VLAN IDs
- Virtual switch
- VM networks

Avoid undocumented VLAN mappings.

---

An access point may map SSIDs to VLANs.

Example:

CORPORATE SSID -> VLAN 10

GUEST SSID -> VLAN 30

The SRX then applies different policy to each security zone.
